prompt_used:
I want to become a Full Stack Developer (Software Engineering). I have 12 months to prepare and I can study 8 hours per day. 
My experience level is University recent CSE graduate. want to focus global market,need fast job, Intermediate (Built small projects) coding experience, familiar with java, C,C++,javascript,typescript,php,kotlin Language and familiar with dot net,node.js,express.js,react framework. build some academic and personal projects & also done intership.preferable language is C# and javascript
Now generate a learning plan for me.

generated_plan.title: 12-Month Full Stack Developer Learning Plan (C# & JavaScript Focus)
generated_plan.goal: Become a Full Stack Software Engineer for the global market, secure a fast job, leveraging C#/.NET and JavaScript/TypeScript/React/Node.js skills.
generated_plan.experience_level: University recent CSE graduate, Intermediate coding experience, familiar with Java, C, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, Kotlin, .NET, Node.js, Express.js, React. Built academic/personal projects, completed an internship.
generated_plan.plan_overview: This plan balances foundational knowledge with deep dives into your preferred full-stack technologies. It integrates daily problem-solving, theoretical learning, and hands-on project building, culminating in robust portfolio projects and intensive interview preparation.

topics: Data Structures & Algorithms (DSA): Daily LeetCode (Easy/Medium)
JavaScript/TypeScript Deep Dive: Advanced JS concepts (closures, prototypes, async/await), TypeScript best practices, ES6+
React.js Foundation: Review Hooks, Context API, React Router, component lifecycle, styling (Tailwind CSS/Styled Components), State management (Redux Toolkit/Zustand)
Version Control: Advanced Git workflows (rebasing, squashing, cherry-picking)
Project: Build a small, responsive static website using React and modern CSS.
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue LeetCode (Medium)
React Ecosystem: Next.js (SSR, SSG, API routes), React Query/SWR for data fetching, unit/integration testing (Jest, React Testing Library)
UI/UX Principles: Design principles, accessibility (a11y), responsive design patterns, component libraries (Material-UI/Chakra UI)
Browser APIs & Performance: Web Workers, IndexedDB, PWA concepts, performance optimization techniques (lazy loading, code splitting)
Project: Rebuild Month 1 project using Next.js, implement advanced features, focus on performance and accessibility.
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue LeetCode (Medium)
C# Deep Dive: Advanced C# (LINQ, Generics, Delegates, Events, Async/Await), OOP, design patterns (Singleton, Factory, Repository)
ASP.NET Core Basics: MVC vs. Web API, Routing, Controllers, Dependency Injection, Middleware, Configuration, RESTful API design
Database Fundamentals: SQL (PostgreSQL/SQL Server) - advanced queries, indexing, joins, ERDs
Project: Build a simple CRUD API using ASP.NET Core and a SQL database (e.g., task manager or blog API).
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue LeetCode (Medium/Hard)
ASP.NET Core Advanced: Authentication/Authorization (JWT, Identity), Error Handling, Logging (Serilog), API versioning, Background tasks
Entity Framework Core: ORM concepts, Code-First vs. Database-First, Migrations, eager/lazy loading, query optimization
Testing in .NET: Unit testing (xUnit/NUnit/MSTest), integration testing for APIs
Project: Enhance Month 3 API with authentication, more complex data models, implement best practices.
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue LeetCode (Medium/Hard)
Node.js Deep Dive: Event loop, streams, clusters, child processes, asynchronous programming patterns, best practices
Express.js & Ecosystem: Middleware, routing, error handling, validation (Joi/Zod), authentication (Passport.js/JWT)
NoSQL Databases: MongoDB - Mongoose ORM, aggregations, indexing, SQL vs. NoSQL use cases
Project: Build a separate CRUD API using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB (e.g., e-commerce product catalog API).
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue LeetCode (Medium/Hard)
Connecting Frontend & Backend: Integrate React/Next.js with C#/.NET backend, understand CORS, basic API Gateway concepts
Authentication & Authorization: Implement JWT-based authentication across the full stack, Role-based access control
Project: Develop a significant full-stack application using React/Next.js and C#/.NET (e.g., Social media clone, project management tool).
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue LeetCode (Medium/Hard)
Connecting Frontend & Backend: Integrate React/Next.js with Node.js/Express.js backend
Real-time Communication: WebSockets (Socket.IO for Node.js, SignalR for .NET). Build chat features or live updates
Project: Develop another significant full-stack application with React/Next.js and Node.js/Express.js, incorporating real-time features (e.g., Live dashboard, collaborative whiteboard).
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue LeetCode (Medium/Hard)
Containerization (Docker): Dockerfile, Docker Compose, container networking, deploying containerized apps
Cloud Platform Basics: Choose one (AWS - EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, API Gateway; or Azure - App Service, Azure SQL, Functions, Cosmos DB). Understand IaaS, PaaS, Serverless
CI/CD Basics: Concepts of Continuous Integration/Deployment. GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps Pipelines for simple project
Project: Containerize one full-stack project and deploy to chosen cloud platform. Set up a basic CI/CD pipeline.
DSA & Problem Solving: Focus on Hard problems
Advanced Docker & Kubernetes Intro: Multi-stage builds, Docker best practices, Kubernetes concepts (Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress - grasp basics, no mastery needed)
System Design Fundamentals: Scalability, availability, fault tolerance, load balancing, caching, message queues, microservices architecture (understand 'why' and 'when')
Monitoring & Logging: Tools like Prometheus/Grafana or cloud-specific solutions. ELK stack basics
Project: Refactor a project into a simple 'microservice-like' architecture and redeploy. Practice designing a simple system.
DSA & Problem Solving: Continue Hard problems
Frontend Performance: Web Vitals, performance profiling, image optimization, code splitting, tree shaking, service workers
Backend Performance: Database query optimization, caching strategies (Redis), asynchronous processing, message queues (RabbitMQ/Kafka basics)
Security Best Practices: OWASP Top 10, XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection, secure coding practices, API security, input validation
Project: Audit one project for performance bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities. Implement improvements.
DSA & Problem Solving: Daily review of key DSA concepts and patterns

Portfolio Refinement: Choose 2-3 best full-stack projects. Ensure documentation, deployment, clean code, READMEs, live demos, and potentially video walkthroughs. Document thought processes and challenges.
Networking & LinkedIn: Optimize LinkedIn, connect with recruiters, tailor learning based on job descriptions
Advanced Topics: Explore GraphQL, gRPC, WebAssembly (briefly), deeper dive into serverless or a specific cloud service
Project: Final polish on portfolio projects.
DSA & Problem Solving: Intensive LeetCode practice, common interview patterns, mock interviews
System Design Interview Prep: Practice system design questions, understand trade-offs, discuss architectural choices
Behavioral Interview Prep: Prepare answers for common behavioral questions (STAR method)
Resume & Cover Letter: Tailor for specific jobs, highlight projects and skills
Mock Interviews: Conduct technical and behavioral mock interviews with peers/mentors
Job Application: Aggressively apply for full-stack developer positions.

general_recommendations.daily_routine: Allocate 1-2 hours for DSA, 4-5 hours for core learning (tutorials, docs), and 2-3 hours for project building/coding practice.
resources: Courses: Udemy, Coursera, Pluralsight, Frontend Masters (reputable instructors like Maximilian Schwarzmüller, Stephen Grider, Nick Chapsas)
Documentation: Official docs (React, Next.js, ASP.NET Core, Node.js, Express.js, Docker, AWS/Azure)
Blogs/Articles: Medium, dev.to, freeCodeCamp, tech-specific blogs
Books: 'Clean Code', 'Design Patterns', 'Head First Design Patterns', 'Designing Data-Intensive Applications' (for System Design)
general_recommendations.community: Participate in developer communities (Discord, Stack Overflow).
general_recommendations.breaks: Schedule regular breaks to avoid burnout. 8 hours/day is intensive.
general_recommendations.hands_on_learning: Emphasize project work. Build things from scratch, apply what you learn, don't just follow tutorials.
general_recommendations.prioritization: While both C# and Node.js are covered, be ready to deep dive into one more if a job opportunity demands. C# is a strong enterprise choice.
general_recommendations.portfolio: Document every project well on GitHub with clear READMEs, live demos. Seek code reviews from experienced developers.
